name: krawings-department-device
description: Capacitor wrapper (appId de.krawings.station) around https://portal.krawings.de — the shared 'Krawings Department Device' kitchen tablet app. Built by .github/workflows/build-station.yml, which runs Capacitor with this folder as its CWD and resolves @capacitor/* from the repo-root node_modules. The android/ project is generated per build and gitignored.
